notes.title: Release Date revealed!
notes.notes:
Try 'n Cry - Prologue will be released on the next [b]Friday 13th December[/b]!

So just few days before the finish line of our Prologue... thus, save the date!

notes.title: A stunning result for Try 'n Cry - Prologue at GameRome 2019!
notes.notes:
We lived extraordinary emotions during the [b]GameRome[/b] week, where so many experts gave us their positive feedbacks about the story behind and the gameplay.

Since the start of this project, we have been putting all our passion in every aspect of the development process, day by day, task by task. Thus, being awarded by such a competent jury is really a dream coming true!

We are proud to announce that [b]Try 'n Cry - Prologue won the "Best Artistic Achievement" and the "Best of Showcase" categories[/b] of GameRome Awards (powered by Xsolla)!

This fantastic outcome filled us with new extraordinary energy to complete the last few tasks before the release... we've almost done!

Just keep in touch!

notes.title: Localization in Progress
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We are almost at the end of our development! Few weeks to release the Prologue...

Also, we are working hard to complete the Localization package to support properly all the languages!

And in few days we'll publish the Release Date!

Stay tuned.
